bio.text: Wendy Rogers is a Republican member of the Arizona State Senate representing District 7; she assumed office on January 9, 2023, and she advanced from the July 21, 2026 Republican primary and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot.
She was born in Fort Knox, Kentucky, and served in the U.S. Air Force from 1976 to 1996, reaching the rank of lieutenant colonel.

She earned a bachelor's degree in social work from Michigan State University in 1976, a master's degree in social work from the University of Alabama, and a master's degree in national security studies from California State University, San Bernardino.
Her career experience includes owning HouseMaster Home and Termite Inspections and working as a real estate salesperson, clinical social worker, flight instructor and substitute teacher.
